plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown read-only.

layer.move: Move popup window — arrow keys to move, Home to reset

admin.title: Popups
admin.description: When several popups match, they rotate inside one layer in list order.

summary.title: {{count}} showing now
summary.order_hint: Shown in the carousel in this order
summary.empty: No popups are showing right now.

delete.title: Delete popup
delete.warning: Deleting also removes image files and cannot be undone. To take a popup down temporarily, hide it instead.

copy.title: Copy popups
copy.message: Copy {{count}} selected popups. Copies are added inactive at the end.

reorder.title: Reorder popups
reorder.description: Popups higher in the list are shown first. Drag or use the ↑↓ buttons, then save.

preview.title: Preview
preview.mobile_falls_back: No mobile image, so the PC image is shown.

conflict.message: Another administrator saved this popup first. Your input is kept. Compare it with the latest version and save again.
conflict.open_latest: Open the latest version in a new tab

form.title: Admin title
form.title_hint: Shown only in the admin list.
form.locale_hint: Languages left empty show the site default language content.

image.pc_hint: Recommended: the PC size in settings ({{width}}×{{height}}) · up to {{mb}}MB · JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF
image.mobile_hint: If not added, the PC image is used on mobile. Up to {{mb}}MB.
image.size_mismatch: The uploaded image is {{width}}×{{height}}. If it differs from the recommended size ({{recommended}}), it is fitted without cropping and may leave margins.

form.image_alt_hint: Read aloud to visitors who cannot see the screen. If empty, the admin title is used.
form.link_url_optional: (optional · opened when the image is clicked)
form.link_url_hint: Enter a site path starting with / or an http(s) address.
form.body_placeholder: Enter the content visitors will see.
form.editor_hint: If an editor plugin (e.g. CKEditor5) is installed it is used; otherwise the basic input is used. Disallowed tags and attributes are removed on save.
form.saved_sanitized: Saved. Some disallowed formatting was removed.
form.route_hint: Enter a path starting with '/'. /shop also covers sub-paths like /shop/products/1 but not /shopping. '/' shows only on the home page.

route_errors.too_many: Up to 20 paths can be specified.

form.period_hint: Shown automatically at the start and taken down automatically at the end.

period.incomplete: Enter both start and end to see the status after saving.
period.hint: If saved now, it will show as "{{status}}".

form.upload_pending: Uploading images. You can save when it finishes.

conflict_merge.title: Compare the latest version with my changes
conflict_merge.hint: Items changed by another administrator default to the latest value and items you changed default to yours. Choose items both of you changed, apply, then review and save again.
conflict_merge.no_differences: Your input matches the latest version. Apply to save again based on the latest version.
conflict_merge.load: Load and compare the latest version
conflict_merge.load_failed: Could not load the latest version. Your input is kept. Please try again.
conflict_merge.choose_all: Choose every item both of you changed before applying.
conflict_merge.stale_image: This image was already replaced or removed by another administrator and cannot be reused.

settings.title: Popup plugin settings
settings.description: The display set here applies to every popup.

pc.title: On PC
pc.size_hint: Content area size · also shown as the recommended image size

mobile_style.center_desc: A small window in the middle

behavior.title: Background · carousel
behavior.close_on_backdrop: Close when the background is clicked

dismiss.title: Close options
dismiss.hint: "Don't show" hides the popups shown at that moment for the period; popups added later appear right away. This record is a strictly necessary cookie and is listed in the GDPR cookie list.

max_upload_mb.label: Maximum image size (MB)
max_upload_mb.hint: Maximum size of one popup image (1–10).
max_upload_mb.server_limit: Files larger than the server PHP upload_max_filesize or post_max_size are rejected even if this value is higher. Current server limit: {{mb}}MB
max_upload_mb.over_server_limit: The setting is larger than the server limit ({{mb}}MB). Only files up to the server limit can be uploaded.

public_cache_minutes.label: Popup cache time on user screens (minutes)
public_cache_minutes.hint: Set 0 to disable caching. Saving, deleting or reordering popups is reflected immediately, and the cache also expires at scheduled start and end times.
